fields.options: This settings page has no desktop icon or Workspace entry by design. To find it again, use the Awesome Bar (the search box at the top of Desk) and search for GNU Terry Pratchett Settings.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Master switch. When off, the X-Clacks-Overhead header is never added, regardless of the scope below.

fields.label: Apply To
fields.options:
Both
Website Pages Only
Desk Pages Only
fields.description: Website pages are anything served outside /desk (web pages, portal, print, web forms). Desk pages are the /desk app shell.

fields.label: Overhead Names
fields.description: Each row becomes one name in the X-Clacks-Overhead header, joined with commas. "GNU Terry Pratchett" ships as the first row; add more names to keep them going. See gnuterrypratchett.com.
